title: The $\mathcal{N}=4$ Bethe Ansatz beyond $\mathrm{SU}(N)$
summary: We solve the Bethe Ansatz equations (BAEs) to evaluate the superconformal index of four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=4$ super-Yang--Mills with rank-two gauge algebra, at equal angular momentum fugacities $p=q$. The solutions for $A_2$ are known, and those for $D_2\cong A_1\oplus A_1$ follow readily from the (equally known) $A_1$ ones. The first genuinely new case is $B_2\cong C_2$, for which we obtain the complete solution set in closed form; for the exceptional case $G_2$ our results are numerical, with a single fully rational solution obtained in closed form.
